summary: Full E2E validation of the Champions Trophy Wall feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest passing (public read, admin auth, year validation, empty teamName validation, edit->public propagation->restore, other domains regression). Frontend: /champions landing (trophy emblem, title, eyebrow, subtitle, placeholder notice, timeline, 6 year cards 2020-2025, 10 record cards) all render; /champions/2025 detail page (edition, title, score chip, hero photo, 4 roster with Captain flag on #1, 4 stat cards, story, quote, 3 moments, MVP, awards, 3 gallery frames) all render; prev/next navigation correct on 2025 (prev only) and 2020 (next only); back link works; invalid years /champions/1999 and /champions/abc both redirect to /champions. Admin: login OK, admin-nav-champions link visible, /admin/champions loads with 6 champion editors + 10 record editors + Add buttons; edit 2025 team name -> save -> public reflects change -> restore works; empty teamName save shows save-error (backend 422 confirmed in console); Add Champion Year creates 2026 editor; two-step delete removes it; save clears the addition. Regression: all 9 public routes render with 0 JS console errors; nav at 1920/1280 has no overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth); mobile menu shows Champions link at 390px; /champions and /champions/2024 have no horizontal overflow at 390px. Final DB state restored: 6 entries, 10 records, 2025=Team Caddie, all placeholder=true.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ChampionDetail redirect logic on line 29 (`if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(yearParam ?? '') || (live && !entry))`) does not redirect for 4-digit years that don't exist in the fallback data while live data is still loading — user sees a brief null flash before live data arrives. Currently mitigated because fallback covers 2020-2025 and admin data seeds the same. Acceptable for MVP.

test_credentials.md documents organizer@dalleoopen.com but the app actually accepts joseffaroldi@yahoo.com/Test123 (as passed to me). Recommend updating test_credentials.md to match the real seeded organizer to avoid future testing confusion.
Backend PUT wrapper: /api/admin/champions requires body wrapped in {"data": {...}}. This is consistent with other admin domains but not documented in test_credentials.md; harmless.
test_credentials: Used joseffaroldi@yahoo.com / Test123 as provided by main agent — login succeeded. Note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still references organizer@dalleoopen.com (mismatch).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded placeholder data. Test explicitly restored 2025 team name to 'Team Caddie' and removed transient 2026 entry so final DB state matches original placeholder seed (6 entries, 10 records, all placeholder=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Champions feature is stable end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_champions.py can be re-run for regression. Note the PUT admin API expects body wrapped as {"data": {...}}. Two-step ConfirmDelete button: first click on [data-testid=champion-delete-YEAR] shows a 'Confirm delete' button (get_by_role("button", name="Confirm delete")), that button must be clicked to actually remove. Framer-motion reveals need ~2s wait + scroll to hydrate whileInView content on detail page.
